title: Control of Nonconforming Product
purpose: Prevent nonconforming parts from being used or shipped and decide what happens to them.
scope: All raw material, work in progress and finished parts at the Leeds site, including customer returns.

definitions.MRB: Material Review Board: quality engineer, production manager and, for use-as-is, the customer

steps.action: Attach a red HOLD tag and move the parts to the quarantine cage within 1 hour
Review the NCR and decide disposition (rework, repair, scrap, return, use-as-is) within 2 working days
Request a customer concession before any use-as-is or repair disposition
Carry out rework to the approved instruction and return the parts for re-inspection
Raise a corrective action (QP-08) for repeat or customer-impacting nonconformities
